abduction.title: Abduction
abduction.info: Peirce's third mode of inference: reason backward from a surprising clue to the hypothesis that would make it unsurprising. Deduction derives, induction counts, abduction invents the best guess. Behind every Inference tier in this book.

apomorphy.title: Apomorphy
apomorphy.info: A derived novelty a lineage invented — not the ancestral default. Shared, it becomes a synapomorphy and binds a clade; unique, an autapomorphy that only labels one tip. Click a node to watch the novelty appear on its descendants.
apomorphy.hint: Tap a node — the novelty lights its descendants

autapomorphy.title: Autapomorphy
autapomorphy.info: A derived trait unique to one tip — useless for grouping, dangerous when long branches pile them up and chance matches fool parsimony. Select a lineage; only its private magenta mark glows.
autapomorphy.hint: Select a tip — only its private novelty lights

clade.title: Clade
clade.info: A common ancestor and every descendant — no one left out. The only real unit in modern classification. Tap a node; the whole limb lights. Compare a monophyletic cut with a non-monophyletic one.
clade.hint: Tap a node to cut a clade

cladogram.title: Cladogram
cladogram.info: A branching hypothesis of kinship. Only order matters — branch lengths are arbitrary. Rearrange six Pandoran tips; the parsimony score counts evolutionary steps. The true tree needs the fewest.

demarcation-problem.title: Demarcation Problem
demarcation-problem.info: Where does science end and non-science begin? Popper bet on falsifiability; Kuhn on paradigms; Lakatos on progressive programmes. Place each claim on the dial — falsifiable ones glow cyan.

falsifiability.title: Falsifiability
falsifiability.info: Popper's gate: a claim is scientific only if some observation could, in principle, prove it wrong. Flip each card — risky bets glow cyan; unfalsifiable claims mute.

homologous-structures.title: Homologous Structures
homologous-structures.info: Same deep plan, different jobs — inherited from one ancestor. Human arm, whale flipper, bat wing share bone order. Tap to reveal the shared scaffold; contrast with analogy's zero kinship.

inference-to-the-best-explanation.title: Inference to the Best Explanation
inference-to-the-best-explanation.info: Harman's sharpened abduction: among rivals for one fact, take the one that explains it best — by testability, scope, conservatism, simplicity. Rate each card; the best-fit glows brightest.

long-branch-attraction.title: Long-Branch Attraction
long-branch-attraction.info: Parsimony's Achilles heel: two fast lineages pile up chance matches and get pulled together at the root — a clean wrong tree. Toggle standard vs corrected; watch the false cluster dissolve.

maximum-parsimony.title: Maximum Parsimony
maximum-parsimony.info: Among trees, prefer the one needing the fewest evolutionary changes. Occam on the tree of life. Toggle topologies; the score counts steps — the minimum lights teal.

occams-razor.title: Occam's Razor
occams-razor.info: Do not multiply assumptions beyond necessity. Between two explanations, prefer fewer new entities — not because simple is true, but because extra miracles carry the burden of proof. Count the links; cut the waste.

outgroup.title: Outgroup
outgroup.info: A known earlier branch that roots the tree — the compass for ancestral vs derived. Drag which tip is outgroup; the ingroup polarity flips with it.

paraphyly.title: Paraphyly
paraphyly.info: Ancestor plus some — not all — descendants. A truncated limb: 'reptiles' without birds, 'fish' without tetrapods. Toggle the missing branch back in to restore a clade.

phenetics.title: Phenetics
phenetics.info: Group by overall similarity — fatal when convergence mimics kinship. Toggle phenetic clustering vs cladistic shared-derived; watch the trees disagree.

plesiomorphy.title: Plesiomorphy
plesiomorphy.info: The ancestral default everyone still carries. Five digits in tetrapods: true, but useless for grouping because nearly all tips share it. Light the base trait across the whole tree.

polyphyly.title: Polyphyly
polyphyly.info: A basket of separate lineages glued by surface resemblance — not a limb of the tree. 'Flying animals' or Na'vi+human bipeds. Toggle the false circle; true roots stay far apart.

positive-citation-bias.title: Positive Citation Bias
positive-citation-bias.info: Exciting positives get cited; nulls vanish. Claims harden with each citation though no new evidence arrives — how the wood-wide web outran its data. Run trials; watch only positives file.

speculation.title: Speculation
speculation.info: This book's tier for a model that grants one unconfirmed premise, then obeys every remaining law. Drag claims across Canon / Inference / Speculation / Real-science. Bend one rule; pay full price elsewhere.
speculation.hint: Place each claim on a tier

symplesiomorphy.title: Symplesiomorphy
symplesiomorphy.info: An ancestral trait many species still share — the cladistic trap. Grouping by it yields paraphyly. Only shared derived traits bind true clades. Pick the old mark; watch the false group fail.
symplesiomorphy.hint: Group by the old trait — see it fail

synapomorphy.title: Synapomorphy
synapomorphy.info: A derived novelty inherited by two or more species from one ancestor — the hard evidence of a clade. Pick the shared mark; a valid monophyletic group lights cyan.
